author: Marcus Vance (Shift Lead Alpha)
summary: OAuth2 Token Generation 500 Spike & Verification Failures across Enterprise Apps
content: At 07:10 UTC, automated alerting reported a severe spike in OAuth2 token verification failures (401/500 errors) across enterprise downstream applications (HR Portal, Payment Gateway, Developer Platform). Initial triage indicated a Vault key rotation to signing key v4.1 at 07:00 UTC. SRE team attempted rate limit adjustments and Redis session pool flushes. Handover required due to shift transition at 09:30 UTC.

author: Elena Rostova (Shift Lead Beta - Incoming)
content: Inspected API Gateway logs. Token issuance by Identity Core pod cluster is succeeding (200 OK), but API Edge Gateways are rejecting 42% of JWT tokens. Hypothesis H1 (Vault rotation) supported by Gateway key cache TTL (4h). Hypothesis H2 (Redis memory pressure) refutes direct causation due to pool memory remaining under 45% threshold.
